title: Pushout products of free fixed-object simplicial-category cells
statement: Let $O$ be a small set, let $\mathrm{sCat}_O$ carry the fixed-object model structure of [lem-coef-fixed-object-simplicial-free-calculus] (local weak equivalences and local Kan fibrations), and for $u,v\in O$, the case $u=v$ allowed, let $F^O_{u,v}:\mathrm{sSet}\to\mathrm{sCat}_O$ be the free-arrow functor of [lem-coef-fixed-object-free-arrow-adjunction]. For a small simplicial set $X$ and $C\in\mathrm{sCat}_O$ define $X\otimes C\in\mathrm{sCat}_O$ by letting $(X\otimes C)_n$ be the coproduct, among ordinary categories with object set $O$ and identity-on-objects functors, of copies $C_n^{(x)}$ of $C_n$ indexed by $x\in X_n$, a simplicial operator $\alpha$ sending the copy indexed by $x$ to the copy indexed by $\alpha^*x$ through $\alpha^*$; this is functorial in $X$ and $C$. Use simplicial sets, boundary and horn inclusions, monomorphisms and weak homotopy equivalences of [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper]. Let $i:K\hookrightarrow L$ be a boundary inclusion $\partial\Delta^m\hookrightarrow\Delta^m$ ($m\geq0$) or a horn inclusion $\Lambda^m_k\hookrightarrow\Delta^m$ ($m\geq1$), and let $j:P\hookrightarrow Q$ be any monomorphism of simplicial sets. Write $i\mathbin\square j:(Q\times K)\amalg_{P\times K}(P\times L)\to Q\times L$ and $$F^O_{u,v}(i)\mathbin\square j:(Q\otimes F^O_{u,v}(K))\amalg_{P\otimes F^O_{u,v}(K)}(P\otimes F^O_{u,v}(L))\longrightarrow Q\otimes F^O_{u,v}(L),$$ the pushout taken in $\mathrm{sCat}_O$. Then there are isomorphisms $X\otimes F^O_{u,v}(Y)\cong F^O_{u,v}(X\times Y)$, natural in $X,Y$, under which $F^O_{u,v}(i)\mathbin\square j$ is identified with $F^O_{u,v}(i\mathbin\square j)$. This map is a cofibration of $\mathrm{sCat}_O$, and a trivial cofibration if $i$ is a horn inclusion or $j$ is a weak homotopy equivalence.

source.place: Dwyer--Kan, Section 7.1 and Proposition 7.2, pp.276-277; the free-cell tensor calculation is the degreewise free-generator calculation underlying the simplicial model axiom. Archival copy WANTED.
